newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Air force chief in East Timor dies in glider crash.
newsitem.headline: Air force chief in East Timor dies in glider crash.

text.p: The commander of an Indonesian air force detachment in East Timor died on Wednesday after his powered hang glider crashed in Dili, the official Antara news agency said.
It said Lieutenant-Colonel Daniel Parinding, 42, died after his new ultra-light aircraft plunged to the ground from around 60 metres (195 feet) shortly after taking off on a test flight.
He was dead on arrival at Dili's military hospital.

Indonesia maintains a small air force detachment in the former Portuguese territory it invaded in December 1975 and incorporated as its 27th province the following year in a move not recognised by the United Nations.
